name: @tatzeroko/apex-multiproject-poc
description: Opt-in proof of concept: one Apex language server per SFDX project, routed by owning sfdx-project.json. Not part of the extension.

scripts.ext:package: npm run ext:build && mkdir -p out && cd vscode-ext && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --skip-license -o ../out/tatzeroko-apex-multiproject-experimental.vsix
